title: Luxurious Moroccan Almonds Amlou
description: A rich and creamy Moroccan dessert featuring ground coriander and almonds, perfect for midnight cravings. This no-onion-no-garlic-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional amlou.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the argan oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced almonds and stir-fry until lightly toasted.
In a blender, combine the toasted almonds, honey, ground coriander, and sea salt.
Blend the mixture until smooth and creamy.
With the blender running, slowly add the water and continue blending until the desired consistency is reached.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the amlou chilled, garnished with additional sliced almonds if desired.
